app-bar.$description: Web top bar / mobile app bar content height

list-row.$description: Comfortable mobile list row min height

mark.$description: Product mark in sidebar and mobile app bar (shielded square)

mark-auth.$description: Product mark on auth lockup (shielded square)

mark-public.$description: Public-header unshielded plate height (2:1 plate; 24px square is too small without the navy shield)

nav-icon.$description: US-31/US-32 Owner/Admin nav and tab outline icons (not the product mark)

hero-map.$description: Public landing static street-map image max height (compact web). Caps the visual so it does not dominate like a consumer travel hero. Not a live map viewport.

vehicle-side-slot.$description: US-35–US-39 + US-41 vehicle side appearance preview frame (FRONT/LEFT/RIGHT/BACK). Larger ops preview (~2× prior 96px); still not a gallery hero. List presence uses badge/icon, not this size.

vehicle-side-grid-max.$description: US-41 Images-tab 2×2 grid max width (web). Fits two 176px slots + gap-2 without banner stretch.

vehicle-side-viewer-toolbar.$description: US-42–US-44 side-image viewer chrome bar height (close + zoom). Matches app-bar rhythm; controls remain min-h-hit 44px inside.

brand-bar.$description: Identity accent bar on auth card, sidebar, and public landing header top — same language, not a third accent
